tasks.label: Restart Odoo Service with Logs
tasks.command: docker exec o16 sh -c 'kill $(pgrep -f /usr/bin/odoo) || true && /usr/bin/odoo -c /etc/odoo/odoo.conf &' && docker logs -ft o16

tasks.label: Restart Odoo + Logs + Update All
tasks.command: docker exec o16 sh -c 'kill $(pgrep -f /usr/bin/odoo) || true && /usr/bin/odoo -c /etc/odoo/odoo.conf -d postgres -u all &' && docker logs -ft o16
